title: Massively Parallel Qubit DNA Quantification Using OpenTrons
author: Suzy Huang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.mejc3cn

steps.title: Prepare Configuration and Script Files
steps.instruction: Create a designated folder on the computer and save the following four files into it:

substeps.instruction: Save the provided configuration text as 'config.ini'.
Save the provided Python code for master mix distribution as '1master_mix.py'.
Save the provided Python code for sample distribution as '2sample.py'.
Save the provided helper functions as 'helpers.py'.
Save the provided container definitions as 'container_list.py'.

steps.title: Configure File Paths in Python Scripts
steps.instruction: Edit '1master_mix.py' and '2sample.py' to point to the correct local directory:

substeps.instruction: Update 'cpath' to the full system path of the 'config.ini' file.
Update 'imp_dir' to the full system path of the folder containing the files (the 'cpath' without 'config.ini').

steps.title: Initialize Robot Hardware
steps.instruction: Connect and power on the OpenTrons robot:

substeps.instruction: Plug the robot into the computer USB port and turn it on (verify blue light).
Open the OpenTrons App on the computer.
Select the correct port from the drop-down menu in the upper right corner.
Click 'Yes' when prompted to Home the robot.

steps.title: Calibrate Containers
steps.instruction: Perform a one-time container calibration if it is the first run or if calibrations have shifted:

substeps.instruction: Click on the tiprack container and use 'Move to' to verify the pipette fits the tip accurately.
If calibration is off, move the pipette 20-40mm up in the Z-axis, then slowly move back down while adjusting X and Y to the correct location and press 'Save'.
Repeat the 'Move to' check for all other containers and calibrate as needed.
To drop a tip: Move to the tiprack, raise 20mm in Z-axis, select the pipette in the checklist, and click 'Move to' in the Drop Tip section.

steps.title: Set Up Deck Layout
steps.instruction: Arrange containers on the deck according to the layout description:

substeps.instruction: Place 96-well holders for qubit tubes and a 15ml tube rack for master mix.
When arranging qubit tubes or tips, leave the first column blank, start on the second column, and skip a column between every tip/tube.
For qubit tubes, skip a row between every tube to leave room for open caps.
If making standards: place two empty qubit tubes in a new row behind the last row of samples, and place the container with two standard solutions in slot E3.

steps.title: Configure Run Parameters
steps.instruction: Edit the 'config.ini' file to match the current experimental run:

substeps.instruction: Set 'sample_number' to the total number of samples (excluding standards).
Set 'make_standards' to 'True' if the robot should prepare standards, otherwise 'False'.
Set 'first_tip' to the number of tips already used in the tiprack (0 for a new box).
Save the edited 'config.ini' file.

steps.title: Execute Master Mix Distribution
steps.instruction: Run the first step to distribute qubit solution using the p1000 pipette:

substeps.instruction: Upload '1master_mix.py' to the OpenTrons app.
Click 'Run' and press 'OK' when prompted to home.
The robot will transfer 199µl of qubit solution to each sample tube.
If 'make_standards' is True, 190µl of qubit solution will be transferred to the two standard tubes in the separate row.

steps.title: Execute Sample Distribution
steps.instruction: Run the second step to transfer samples into the master mix using the p10 pipette:

substeps.instruction: If a different robot is used, home the current robot ('All' in home section), power off, and repeat the setup/power-on process for the new robot.
Edit 'config.ini' and update 'first_tip' to the number of rows to skip in the 10µl tiprack.
Upload '2sample.py' to the OpenTrons app.
Click 'Run' and press 'OK' when prompted to home.
The robot will transfer 1µl of each sample to its corresponding qubit tube (alternating odd/even samples across rows).
If 'make_standards' is True, the p10 will transfer 10µl of the necessary standard solution to the standard tubes.
